# Toy library late return rules

The Tamarack Toy Library, a volunteer group that lends toys and games from a room at the Eastgate branch, sets its own rules for late returns. Toys are borrowed for two weeks, and late returns cost 50 cents a day, because the group has few copies of each toy and other families wait for them.

The toy library considered dropping the charge but decided that missing puzzle pieces and late returns hurt its small collection more than they would hurt a library's. Its rules are separate from the library's, and staff cannot change balances in the toy library's notebook.
